name: Proxmox
description: Your Proxmox VE in Swarm: the cluster's nodes, VMs and containers with their graphs; start, shut down, reboot and snapshot them; tasks and their logs; and agents that do the same with swarm proxmox.

settings.title: Servers
settings.description: The Proxmox servers: each one's name, address, how it signs in and the certificate trusted. Proxmox's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: Their secrets
settings.description: Each server's token secret or password, and the ticket it last gave. Proxmox's page of Settings sets it.

settings.title: Current server
settings.description: The server the page and the command line act on. The page's sidebar chooses it.
